library_preparation_preflight.summary: The core client API (DefaultGraphQLClient, GraphQLResponse, GraphQLClient.createCustom with a RequestExecutor lambda, query/response parsing via json-path and Jackson) can be tested with the artifact's own dependencies. It needs no Docker image, environment variable or system property.
risks: In the 10.5.0 POM, spring-web, graphql-java and the Jackson modules are runtime-scope. Test code cannot compile against Spring classes such as RestClient or RestTemplate unless a dependency is added explicitly. The WebClient and RestClient-based client variants (WebClientGraphQLClient, RestClientGraphQLClient) would also need spring-webflux or spring-web at test compile time. Keep coverage on the RequestExecutor-based path unless the generator finds it needs those variants.

The only existing DGS test project under tests/src/com.netflix.graphql.dgs is for graphql-dgs-subscription-types 10.5.0. It adds jackson-module-kotlin and assertj as test dependencies, so it is not a template for Spring-based tests.
Local Gradle and Native Image runs remain authoritative.
